ai.title: AI
ai.intro: Apps ask the AI for a role, never a model. Here you choose who answers and how much it may spend each month.
ai.provider.none.hint: Without a provider everything works except automatic insights and automatic event discovery.
ai.provider.openai.hint: OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM: any endpoint that speaks the chat completions API.
ai.base_url.hint.anthropic: Leave it empty to use Anthropic directly.
ai.monthly_tokens.hint: Input plus output. Empty means no limit.
ai.key.instance: Without a key of your own, the instance's is used.
ai.attempts.empty: No app has asked the AI yet.
ai.unavailable: The AI settings cannot be read right now.
